note: The PR-8 golden prompts. Prompt 17 upgrades a precon, so the share rule of D-218 runs. Prompts 14 and 15 name no commander, so the generator must pick one. A user who delegates the pick makes D-147 and D-208 skip the slot (D-232). Prompt 13 names a commander the collection does not hold, on purpose: owned-first must warn and still build (D-37). Prompts 2 and 5 name owned commanders, so an accidental warning never hides a real one. Each one is a session whose slots are all answered, which is where the generator takes over. The set covers the three formats the app builds (D-155), both pool modes (D-37), every power shape, and the two build rules that are not rules of the game: the precon share (D-218) and a locked card (D-70). Prompts 19 to 24 are the PR-17B set gate (D-373 to D-383). They cover a two-colour set family, a mono colour, a delegated commander inside the sets, the mana fill of D-382, a named card outside the sets (D-381), and a 60-card set-limited deck. Run them alone with -only 19,20,21,22,23,24. Prompt 25 is the PR-24 gate (D-408): its collection file sits beside the file of the -collection flag and holds Avengers Assemble whole, and the deck must use none of its cards. Run it alone with -only 25.
